evidence: The sample was analyzed by atomic force microscopy (AFM), contact angle measurement, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and Fourier-transformed infrared spectroscopy (FTIR). The XPS analysis confirmed the presence of N, along with a significant increase in the C 1s intensity. The ATR-FTIR analysis showed that the intensity of the CH2 absorption peak increased most significantly after ODTS treatment. The XPS analysis showed that the C, N, and O contents remained relatively constant. The ATR-FTIR analysis (Figure 5e) also confirmed the complete removal of the S-layer proteins and ODTS molecules based on the disappearance of the NH (3297 cm-1), CH3 (2968 and 2866 cm-1), CH2 (2922 cm-1), CO (1645 cm-1), and CN (1525 cm-1) vibration modes.
